headline: Ramayana Day 19: ₹12.70 Cr India nett
lede: Ramayana's Day 19 collection so far, on Tuesday, 24 November 2026, is ₹12.70 Cr India nett and ₹15.15 Cr India gross, -64.3% from Day 18's ₹35.60 Cr. That is across 15,696 shows at 17% occupancy. Updated 05:07 am IST, and still a live estimate rather than the final drop.
body:
Through Day 20 the desk has Ramayana at ₹990.5 Cr India nett, ₹1,162.2 Cr India gross, ₹573.0 Cr overseas and ₹1,735.2 Cr worldwide. Adding the day-wise nett rows gives ₹972.95 Cr, which is a different series from that lifetime nett, so the two are not combined. Behind it on the daily chart, O.M Operation Mole at ₹5.40 Cr and Aakasamlo Oka Tara at ₹3.25 Cr. This day's overseas figure is not in, so it is not used to move the worldwide total.

Trade coverage is still led by Ramayana. India Today is citing about ₹1,700.0 Cr. The desk keeps ₹990.5 Cr India nett and ₹1,735.2 Cr worldwide, and does not blend those reports into its own total. No producer-certified total is included.
